name: h3-chain-story
description: История из 2 сцен (MiniMax-H3, латентный хвост): стартовый кадр → Сцена 1 → продолжение по хвосту (tail → context) → Сцена 2 → склейка

opening_prompt.default: orange tabby cat with white paws sitting in a cozy dusty attic next to an old brass lantern, 3D cartoon, warm golden light, film still

scene1.default: orange tabby cat looks around the dim dusty attic curiously, camera slowly pushes in, soft creaking floorboards and gentle wind, quiet meow, 3D cartoon

scene2.default: the orange tabby cat reaches out with its front paw to the brass lantern and turns the knob, warm golden glow illuminates dusty boxes, camera gently orbits, soft click and quiet purring, 3D cartoon
